name: Patterned Wallpaper
instruction: Design a 3D model of a patterned wallpaper. Start with a rectangular sheet. Add a repeating geometric pattern across the surface. Ensure the pattern is evenly spaced and consistent throughout. The wallpaper should look ready to be applied to a wall.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a rectangular sheet.
The dimensions of the sheet are appropriate for wallpaper.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The pattern is evenly spaced and consistent throughout the sheet.
Texture and surface detail: The surface has a repeating geometric pattern.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The wallpaper is presented as a flat, two-dimensional object.
The edges of the wallpaper are clearly defined.
Object distance and contact: The pattern is applied uniformly without any overlaps.
There are no gaps between the repeating elements of the pattern.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the wallpaper are accurately represented.
The repeating geometric pattern is consistent and evenly spaced.
